description.value: Through your knowledge of traditional kasathan healing rituals and meditative practices, you've learned to cleanse the body and mind of the ill or troubled. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Cleanse Affliction] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Sound Body] as 4th-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.
